newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Adtrans sees steady full year.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Adtrans sees steady full year.

text.p: Australian car and truck retailer Adtrans Group Ltd said on Monday it expected its result for 1996/97 ending June 30 to be at least on track with 1995/96.

"We expect our second half performance will be similar to the opening six months and that the result for the current full year will be at least in line with 1995/96," chairman Graeme Bignell said in a statement.
Adtrans earlier reported a decline in first half net profit to A$2.03 million from A$2.18 million a year earlier.
Bignell said used car markets were tighter in the latest December half due to anticipation of reduced import duty on new cars and the strong Australian dollar.
Adtrans reported a net profit of A$4.03 million in 1995/96.
